articles.title: Delivery truck slams into Mississauga Boston Pizza at Square One; 1 in custody
articles.summary: A large delivery truck crashed into a Boston Pizza restaurant at Square One Shopping Centre in Mississauga overnight, causing extensive damage to the building. Peel Regional Police say the incident happened at around 3 a.m. on Nov. 13 at the popular shopping complex near Hurontario Street and Burnhamthorpe Road. Police confirmed one male was taken […]

articles.title: Man dead in Scarborough house fire
articles.summary: A man has died following a house fire in Scarborough, police say. Emergency responders were called to a home on Marlena Drive, near Lawrence Avenue East and Morningside Avenue, around 6:30 a.m. on Friday. Toronto Fire says crews located one person in the basement of the home with critical injuries. Paramedics transported the man to […]

articles.title: U of T music community celebrates beloved professor Mary Morrison's 100th birthday
articles.summary: Hundreds came together to celebrate the 100th birthday of a beloved music professor at the University of Toronto this week, along with her decades-long career teaching and performing opera.

articles.title: Youth sentenced to two years for two Toronto-area synagogue shootings, police say
articles.summary: The chief of police in a region north of Toronto says a youth has been sentenced after he pleaded guilty to shooting at two synagogues. Paulo Da Silva, chief of York regional police, says the youth was sentenced on Tuesday to two years in a custodial facility followed by one year of community supervision for […]

articles.title: New Scotiabank Arena priority program puts members at the front of the line — at price tag of $2,500
articles.summary: Maple Leaf Sports & Entertainment has launched a new program that gives members first access to tickets for Scotiabank Arena shows at a cost of $2,500 a year, but the price tag is not appealing to everyone.

articles.title: Donald Trump Jr. exits advisory role at prediction market Kalshi
articles.summary: NEW YORK (AP) — Donald Trump Jr. is no longer a paid adviser for Kalshi, the prediction market company said Thursday.

articles.title: U of T rejects report saying school over-polices, under-protects Muslims, Arabs, Palestinians
articles.summary: A review of the University of Toronto's policies and practices has found the school has a "general pattern of over-policing and under-protecting" Muslims, Arabs and Palestinians, with a report laying out dozens of recommendations related to academic freedom, on-campus security methods, institutional autonomy and other concerns.

articles.title: Friend of woman stabbed to death in North York left traumatized after witnessing violent murder
articles.summary: A friend and roommate of a woman who was stabbed to death says she not only witnessed the attack, but tried to help as she saw the horrific scene unfold in the parking lot of the North York apartment building they called home. Gregoria Alilio, 47, was killed in what police are investigating as a […]

articles.title: Feds say Stellantis owes 'hundreds of millions' in subsidies, company offers $24M
articles.summary: Automaker Stellantis says it will pay back $24 million in federal subsidies after it announced plans to sell its Brampton, Ont. assembly plant — but Industry Minister Mélanie Joly says the company owes far more than what it is offering.

articles.title: Meet the 1st woman to run an ultra marathon in Antarctica
articles.summary: Oakville’s Stephanie Case made history after completing a grueling 100-mile race across the frozen continent — pushing through sub-minus-20-degree temperatures, frozen gear, and more than 17 hours of continuous running.

articles.title: Coroner's inquest to examine police-involved shooting death of Mississauga man
articles.summary: A coroner's inquest, initially set for Thursday, will begin on Friday to examine the circumstances surrounding the death of a man who was shot in the head by police west of Toronto nearly seven years ago.

articles.title: Carney aware of 'some aspects' of Stellantis auto plant sale, but says company still broke deal
articles.summary: Prime Minister Mark Carney says he had been informed of "some aspects" of Stellantis's plan to sell an idled Brampton, Ont., auto plant to Canadian armoured vehicle maker Roshel Inc., before the deal was announced.

articles.title: House fire in Ajax 'appears suspicious': Durham police
articles.summary: A house fire in Ajax on Thursday morning is being looked at as a suspicious incident, according to Durham police.

articles.title: Lawyer sues Durham police for $7.1M over alleged violent arrest at Oshawa courthouse
articles.summary: A criminal defence lawyer who alleges she was violently assaulted by Durham Regional Police officers inside an Oshawa courthouse has filed a $7.1-million lawsuit against the regional police service board and five officers.
